tickets.what: 2026-11-27 ~05:05Z three queued lands failed at once with `waiting for f19e4dd6188b00f6e (gate step 3, 0 min): abstract lock timeout (land-queue)` (unattended/13 ff4d4ccd31d0208eb-2, imp-daily-facts/07 f2d9ff6f38e77f4f4, ticket-store/09 fc93b02fed181360a) while another land held the gate. src/mcp/land-runner.ts:127 takes `withAbstractLock('land-queue', …)` with the default 1000 ms timeout (src/utils/abstract-lock.ts:34).
